title: Friday Night Magic 2016: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "The mind of an Eldrazi is a puzzle that can never be solved. The trick is to make sure a piece goes missing." —Jace Beleren
"All these old relics have one thing in common. Every last one of them is made of smithereens." —Zada of Slab Haven
"We came to a place where the skin of Zendikar was peeled back and its bones lay bare to the sky." —Greenweaver Mina
Inspiration comes in all shapes and sizes.
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope." —Nissa Revane
"For those without the Planeswalker spark, the merest touch of the Blind Eternities can kill." —Ugin
Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates." —Ghoulcaller Gisa
At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.
